identificationModule.briefTitle: Neoadjuvant Treatment in Rectal Cancer With Radiotherapy Followed by Atezolizumab and Bevacizumab (TARZAN)
identificationModule.officialTitle: Neoadjuvant Treatment in Rectal Cancer With Radiotherapy Followed by Atezolizumab and Bevacizumab (TARZAN)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: In this study, patients with resectable rectal cancer will receive radiotherapy, followed by neoadjuvant bevacizumab and atezolizumab
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: 38 patients with resectable rectal cancer will be enrolled. All patients will be treated with radiotherapy followed by bevacizumab and atezolizumab.

armGroups.label: bevacizumab and atezolizumab
armGroups.description: 1 cycle of bevacizumab monotherapy, followed by 2 cycles of bevacizumab combined with atezolizumab, followed by 1 cycle of atezolizumab monotherapy

primaryOutcomes.measure: clinical complete and near-complete response rate
primaryOutcomes.description: response rate will be assessed by MRI and endoscopy

secondaryOutcomes.measure: incidence of adverse events following treatment (safety)
secondaryOutcomes.description: adverse events will be assessed (according tot CTC-AE v5) during treatment
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: untill 100 days after last patient last study drug

secondaryOutcomes.measure: local recurrence rate at 1 year follow-up
secondaryOutcomes.description: recurrence will be assessed by MRI and CT scans

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* signed informed consent
* patients age 18 years and older
* histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the rectum
* intermediate risk rectal cancer or low risk distal rectal cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* evidence of metastatic disease
* prior radiation therapy for disease under study
* prior treatment with CD137 agonists or immune checkpoint blockade therapies
* current or recent use of acetylsalicylic acid
* history of clinically significant cardiac or pulmonary dysfunction pregnancy or breastfeeding
* significant auto-immune disease
